daas-irab:1-1.t: ﴿وَيْلٌ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject), in the nominative (marfūʿ). ﴿لِكُلِّ﴾ its khabar (predicate). ﴿هُمَزَةٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿لُمَزَةٍ﴾ a badal (substitute) from it; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:2-2.t: ﴿الَّذِي﴾ a relative noun, a badal (substitute) of the whole for the whole (badal kull min kull). ﴿جَمَعَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿مالًا﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَعَدَّدَهُ﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it.

daas-irab:3-3.t: ﴿يَحْسَبُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿أَنَّ مالَهُ﴾ anna and its noun. ﴿أَخْلَدَهُ﴾ a past verb and its object, and the fāʿil is latent; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of anna, and the interpreted maṣdar (maṣdar muʾawwal) formed from anna and what follows it stands in place of the two objects of يحسب; the clause «يحسب..» is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

daas-irab:4-4.t: ﴿كَلَّا﴾ a particle of deterrence and rebuke (radʿ wa-zajr). ﴿لَيُنْبَذَنَّ﴾ the lām occurs in the response to an omitted oath, and a passive imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is attached to the heavy nūn of emphasis; the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent (mustatir), and the clause is the response to the oath, with no grammatical position. ﴿فِي الْحُطَمَةِ﴾ attached to (mutaʿalliq) what precedes them.

daas-irab:6-6.t: ﴿نارُ اللَّهِ﴾ the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), and the Name of Majesty is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿الْمُوقَدَةُ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa) of نار; the clause is a badal (substitute) from الحطمة.

daas-irab:7-7.t: ﴿الَّتِي﴾ a relative noun, an adjective (ṣifa) of نار. ﴿تَطَّلِعُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿عَلَى الْأَفْئِدَةِ﴾ attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb.

daas-irab:8-8.t: ﴿إِنَّها﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾ attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate). ﴿مُؤْصَدَةٌ﴾ khabar; the nominal clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

daas-irab:9-9.t: ﴿فِي عَمَدٍ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are an adjective (ṣifa) of مؤصدة. ﴿مُمَدَّدَةٍ﴾ an adjective of عمد.
